snail.notes: Side view facing right. Warm ochre shell with a dark shell-dark seam spiralling from the lower-right aperture into a 1px apex, an amber growth band along the shadow-side outer whorl and a cream rim light on the upper-right shoulder; the shell is pixel-identical on all four frames. Soft stone/stone-dark foot and head, two eyestalks with ink tips. 4-frame slow glide, shell held stable: a 2px foot crease and a 1px sole-arch gap travel 2px per frame from the toe (frame 0) to the tail (frame 3), and the stalks act against it - rear tip sways 1px left while the front tip lifts and dips 1px. Contact row 8 stays planted except the travelling arch. No baked shadow; the engine adds the 1px ground shadow at the sole.

waterstrider.notes: Top view facing right. Segmented 1px body on row 3: a clear 3px ink abdomen (x3-x5), a 3px ink-warm thorax (x6-x8) and a 2px ink head (x9-x10). Six visibly connected legs: the two short forelegs lie forward along y2/y4 from the head flanks; the long surface legs are the middle pair (root x7, knee at x8/y1, tarsus lying along surface row 0/6 to the front corners x12) and the trailing hind pair (root x6, foot at x1). Only the four surface feet carry a 1px foam dimple; the lifted middle feet and the held forelegs carry none, and no ripple trails exist. 4-frame rowing loop: middle-out (feet at x12) -> middle-back (dimples slide to x11) -> middle-lift (middle legs tuck, no dimples) -> middle-swing (middle legs reach forward airborne) -> loop. No ground shadow; the dimples are the only contact evidence.
